sources.title: Improving Students' Learning With Effective Learning Techniques – press summary
sources.claim: Practice testing and distributed practice rated high utility; rereading, highlighting and summarisation rated low utility.

sources.title: Test-Enhanced Learning – APS Observer summary
sources.claim: Testing produced substantially greater retention than restudying on 2-day and 1-week delayed tests.

sources.publisher: Instructional Science (summary by M. S. Glessmer)
sources.title: The shuffling of mathematics practice problems boosts learning – summary
sources.claim: Students who mixed problem types outperformed blocked practice on a later test.

sources.title: Recommended Amount of Sleep for Pediatric Populations
sources.claim: Teenagers 13–18 should sleep 8 to 10 hours per 24 hours.
